sn23.2:1.2: nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn23.2:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante satto ti vuccatīti || || 4
sn23.2:1.5: Rūpe kho Rādha yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā tatra satto tatra visatto tasmā satto ti vuccati || || 5-7
sn23.2:1.9: Viññāṇe yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā tatra satto tatra visatto tasmā satto ti vuccati || || 9
sn23.2:2.1: Seyyathāpi Rādha kumārakā vā kumāriyo vā paṃsvāgārakehi kīḷanti || ||
sn23.2:2.2: Yāva kīvañca tesu paṃsvāgārakesu avītarāgā honti avigatachandā avigatapemā avigatapipāsā avigatapariḷāhā avigatataṇhā || tāva tāni paṃsvāgārakāni ālayanti keḷāyanti manāyanti mamāyanti || || 10
sn23.2:2.3: Yato ca kho Rādha kumārakā vā kumāriyo vā tesu paṃsvāgārakesu vigatarāgā honti vigatachandā vigatapemā vigatapipāsā vigatapariḷāhā vigatataṇhā || atha kho tāni paṃsvāgārakāni hatthehi ca pādehi ca vikiranti vidhamanti viddhaṃsenti vikīḷanikaṃ karonti || || 11
sn23.2:2.4: Evam eva kho Rādha tumhe rūpaṃ vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikīḷanikaṃ karotha taṇhakkhayāya paṭipajjatha || || 12-14
sn23.2:2.8: Viññāṇaṃ vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikiḷanikaṃ karotha taṇhakkhayāya paṭipajjatha || ||
sn23.2:2.9: Taṇhakkhayo hi Rādha nibbānan ti || || 1-2 Sāvatthi || || 3
